activity_summary: Alse came up because the hall was done, and she offered bread. You refused it. You told her the flat sheet was the letter and that she was to leave it. She had not taken it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the letter on the board and said good night.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Left the sheet, moved the cat, and went down.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Went from the chronicle to the Chaucer.

facets.activity: Came home and let Alse shift the cat

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: There is bread if you want it.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The letter is the flat one. Leave that one where it is.
